range_decision.evidence: A clear temporary offset appears in the N/E/U series around indices 472–480: at index 472, all three components jump abruptly (N from ~0.77 to -11.64, E from ~-1.45 to -1.95, U from ~-0.48 to -7.01), remain displaced over 8 consecutive samples (indices 472–479), then return sharply at index 480 to values near the pre-offset level (N ~-11.35, E ~-1.17, U ~-8.98), with the trajectory resuming its prior trend. The offset is sustained across multiple samples and reversed in the same axes, satisfying the definition of a temporary observation offset. No other sustained multi-sample offsets with opposing returns are evident.
